description:
## Goal

Compile each byte-identical fixture/configuration/front-door observation once and fan its immutable typed result into every permanent pure ratchet that asks the same question. Preserve two genuinely separate compiler processes per fixture so cross-process determinism remains a real boundary.

## Implemented model

- `TARGET_FIXTURES` is the one deterministic inventory of the three target fixtures and their output goldens.
- `TARGET_OBSERVATION_SPEC` is the single immutable authority for the interp door, public-JSONL telemetry, backend dump, and inherited/fixed environment contract. It constructs the actual `Command` arguments and environment and is carried into every producer and consumer failure.
- `produce_target_observations` injects the real per-process producer seam and calls it twice for each fixture, in deterministic fixture/first-process/second-process order. Its result type has no `Clone` bound, so one process result cannot be cloned into both comparison slots.
- Each `TargetObservation` owns its spec, fixture, and exactly two distinct `ProcessObservation` values. Each process result contains runtime output, stderr, one parsed and replayed `CausalReport`, the canonical callable-resolution set, and the canonical backend dump.
- The public-trace, causal-work, and backend-identity ratchets borrow the same immutable bundle. None compiles, reparses, mutates, caches, or reconstructs it.
- The old causal and backend tests each owned a three-fixture/two-process loop: 6 bundle productions and 12 compiler subprocesses. The combined gate owns 3 bundle productions and 6 compiler subprocesses. The original shorthand 6 -> 3 described bundle productions; this explicit subprocess count is the executable truth.
- There is no global observation cache and no sharing across specs, fixtures, settings, or perturbations.

## Ownership and attribution

- Each process gets unique telemetry and backend paths from the existing process-id plus atomic-nonce allocator.
- One RAII owner reads and removes each output on success and removes partial output on early return. A deliberate partial-production error proves both owned paths disappear without explicit consumption. A 32-thread test proves paths are collision-free, content stays with its owner, and no residue remains.
- `ObservationFailure` carries the same spec used to construct the command plus the exact fixture, producing process or cross-process phase, named ratchet, and detail. A changed-spec test proves command args, fixed environment overrides, and diagnostics move together. Deliberately broken synthetic observations prove all three consumer labels independently.

## Ratchet contracts

- `public-trace` preserves successful golden output, empty stderr, recursive-search non-vacuity, complete canonical dictionaries, no undefined first use, the f98 zero-uncaused constraint, and no unknown callable surface type.
- `causal-work` preserves equal runtime output, more than 1,000 canonical work entries per fixture, and exact canonical multiset equality between the two processes.
- `backend-identity` preserves a non-vacuous backend, no raw `Ty` rendering, exact canonical callable-resolution identity, and byte-identical canonical backend output.
- Fixture-matrix expected-fatal, panic, timeout, filter, readiness, telemetry, and build-output classifications are untouched. This ticket neither changes nor duplicates the distinct fz-tfn.28 readiness race and fz-tfn.29 fixture telemetry ownership work.

## Required deletion

Deleted the second three-fixture producer loop, duplicated fixture inventories and filters, four independent backend/trace path variables per fixture, duplicate public-trace parsing and callable projection, old per-ratchet manual cleanup, and the superseded superficial bundle counter. No compatibility adapter, global cache, or temporary scaffold remains.

## TDD and verification

- RED at the actual injected process-production seam: a deliberate extra producer call reported 9 invocations versus the required 6. The sentinel result records unique invocation, fixture, and first/second process identity; the non-`Clone` seam prevents aliasing one result into both slots.
- GREEN exact oracle: 3 bundles, 6 distinct producer invocations, and deterministic fixture/process order.
- GREEN affected filter: oracle, changed-spec command/diagnostic coupling, three deliberate consumer attribution failures, partial-error Drop cleanup, 32-way ownership, and the real combined ratchet all passed 6/6 in 41.87 seconds (41.97 wall).
- GREEN full affected integration target: 29/29 in 42.61 seconds (42.72 wall).
- GREEN workspace all-target/all-feature check with warnings denied in 16.02 seconds and strict clippy with warnings denied. Formatting and staged diff checks passed.
- Library and production sources are unchanged by the review corrections; the same branch's proportional full library gate already passed 1,774 with 6 ignored in 87.69 seconds.
- `.agent/docs/performance-instrumentation.md` names the combined reproduction command, one-spec ownership model, early-return cleanup, and exact 6 bundles / 12 subprocesses -> 3 bundles / 6 subprocesses reduction.

Durations are corroborative only. The compile-count oracle is the deterministic performance signal.

## Final acceptance state

Frozen staged binary-diff SHA-256: `84175f46793d3d8f72c19b25005c57802f579782a6d46eef5b07f1ccf2ccad69`. The index contains only `.agent/docs/performance-instrumentation.md` and `tests/fz2_cli.rs`; it is uncommitted and unpushed pending ticket-scoped cold adversarial review. Any review correction requires a new frozen SHA-256 before the one ticket commit and close.
title: Compile each fixture observation once and fan permanent ratchets over it
